questions.question: True or False: Ryan Giggs scored in 21 consecutive Premier League seasons.
questions.anchorClues: Ryan Giggs scored in every single Premier League campaign from the competition's inaugural 1992–93 season through to the 2012–13 season.

questions.question: Which match stands as the highest-scoring fixture in Premier League history, featuring 11 total goals?
questions.anchorClues: Portsmouth defeated Reading 7–4 at Fratton Park on 29 September 2007, setting the record for the highest-scoring fixture in Premier League history.

questions.question: Which club conceded the fewest goals in a single Premier League season, allowing just 15 goals across 38 matches?
questions.anchorClues: Under José Mourinho, Chelsea conceded a record-low 15 goals in 38 matches during the 2004–05 season, keeping 25 clean sheets.

questions.question: Who holds the all-time record for the most penalty saves in Premier League history, stopping 13 spot-kicks?
questions.anchorClues: David James saved 13 penalties during his Premier League career across spells with Liverpool, Aston Villa, West Ham, Manchester City, and Portsmouth.

questions.question: Which player holds the record for the most goals scored off the bench as a substitute in Premier League history?
questions.anchorClues: Jermain Defoe scored 24 Premier League goals after coming on as a substitute, more than any other player in the competition's history.

questions.question: Who scored the first goal in Premier League history, finding the net for Sheffield United against Manchester United on 15 August 1992?
questions.anchorClues: Brian Deane scored after just five minutes for Sheffield United in a 2–1 victory over Manchester United on opening day of the inaugural Premier League season.

questions.question: Which player shares the all-time Premier League record for the most red cards in competition history, being sent off 8 times alongside Duncan Ferguson and Richard Dunne?
questions.anchorClues: Patrick Vieira was sent off 8 times during his Premier League career with Arsenal and Manchester City, sharing the all-time red card record with Duncan Ferguson and Richard Dunne.

questions.question: In December 2025, Erling Haaland became the fastest player to reach 100 Premier League goals. How many matches did he take to reach the century mark?
questions.anchorClues: Erling Haaland scored his 100th Premier League goal in just his 111th match, comfortably surpassing Alan Shearer's previous record of 124 matches.

questions.question: Which player was the first in Premier League history to register four assists in a single match, doing so in February 1999 against Leicester City?
questions.anchorClues: Dennis Bergkamp set the record during Arsenal's 5–0 win over Leicester City on 20 February 1999, becoming the first player to register four assists in a single Premier League game.

questions.question: Which defender holds the all-time Premier League record for scoring the most own goals, putting the ball into his own net 10 times?
questions.anchorClues: Richard Dunne put the ball into his own net 10 times across 431 Premier League appearances for Everton, Manchester City, Aston Villa, and QPR.
